supported_diagnostic.procedure: Use actual built vw_pdf embed_pdf_copy_metadata and verify_pdf_copy_metadata on one-page synthetic PDFs, with LF/CRLF/CR classic-xref rows and two consecutive metadata stamps. Independently read all six with strict pypdf; check exact Subject JSON, u64 maxima, full hashes, paired capture identity, page box, no Prev/Encrypt.
supported_diagnostic.checker_python_source:
from pathlib import Path
from pypdf import PdfReader
import hashlib,json
root=Path('/tmp/vw-pdf-gate-feasibility');rows=[]
for path in sorted(root.glob('*.pdf')):
    expected=json.loads(path.with_suffix('.expected.json').read_text())
    reader=PdfReader(path,strict=True)
    assert len(reader.pages)==1
    assert list(reader.pages[0].mediabox)==[0,0,10,10]
    assert reader.metadata is not None
    actual=json.loads(reader.metadata.subject)
    assert actual==expected
    assert actual['host_seq']==2**64-1 and actual['frame_id']==2**64-1
    assert actual['revision']=='r18446744073709551615-abababab'
    assert len(actual['state_hash'])==len(actual['source_asset'])==64
    assert '/Prev' not in reader.trailer and '/Encrypt' not in reader.trailer
    rows.append({'fixture':path.name,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'strict_page_and_subject_readback':'passed'})
(root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'parser':'pypdf6.10.0','synthetic_cases':rows,'passed':len(rows),'pdfium_gate_passed':False,'native_runtime_or_isolation_claim':False},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Independent strict pypdf checks passed:',len(rows))
